notes.subject: ותבלעני
notes.rationale: Botegi bja lentšu ke 'a a nkamela' (swallow); KJV/JPS di fetolela 'o a nsenya' — sebopego sa go kamela se latela sebopego sa go bopa

notes.subject: עצב
notes.rationale: עצב go bolela go bopa/kgata (carve) le go hlotša (worry); dikgoreletso tše pedi tša Jobe di tswa lentšung le tee

notes.subject: go Elohim
notes.rationale: Jobe o bolela le yena ka go itseba: o mo bopa gomme o mo kamela

translation: Matogo a gago a nkgetha, gomme a n-dirile ka mmogo go dikologa, gomme bjale o a nmela.
